blocks.text: The premise is not supported for the agreed comparison: September 2026 net revenue rose $355.58 (3.62%) from August, from $9,819.93 to $10,175.51 (check 4).

items: Subscription net revenue rose $339.66; PPV rose $15.92. Together they reconcile to the $355.58 increase (check 5).
More initial subscription charges were partly offset by fewer renewals; this is an accounting decomposition, not a proven explanation of customer behavior (check 7).
Confirm whether a different KPI or period motivated the original concern.
